newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HAJDUTEJ UNMOVED AS NUTRICIA TALKS STOP.
newsitem.headline: HAJDUTEJ UNMOVED AS NUTRICIA TALKS STOP.

text.p: Hungarian dairy company Hajdutej shares remained apparently intact by news that its majority owner, the Dutch food group Nutricia and Friesland NV had called off talks on commercial cooperation.

The talks were aimed at combining or swapping some of the two firms' activities and included swaps of production and marketing of dairy products from Nutricia to Friesland in a number of countries, including Hungary.
Traders said there had not been any deals in Hajdutej stocks since the beginning of the Friday session. Offer prices ranged between 1,350 forints and 2,300 forints but there were no bids.
On Thursday Hajdutej stocks closed at 1,300 forints.
